concerns.text: The Edge Cases section specifies three required behaviors — (1) graceful handling of an empty/underpowered 'rare event' subset, (2) enforced bounds on λ (0 < λ < 10) to prevent numerical instability, and (3) fail-fast with a clear error on FAISS HNSW index corruption — but NO functional requirement (FR-001..FR-008) covers any of them. These are stated behaviors with no FR/SC backing; add FRs (and SCs where measurable) or remove the edge cases.

US-3 scenario 2 requires the final report to 'explicitly flag any significant degradation in short-term performance for manual review', but FR-007 only verifies the 5% tolerance; no FR requires the flagging/reporting behavior. Re-anchor by extending FR-007 or adding an FR to cover the reporting requirement.
